headline: Hi,

scenes.line: Hi, I'm Zack. I'll walk you through setting up AgentStack, one small step at a time.

headline: Every
lead.
*One*
*inbox.*
scenes.line: First, let's connect the place your leads already reach you. That way, every message lands in one inbox, and nothing slips through the cracks.

headline: Pick
the
one
you
*check most.*
scenes.line: Pick the one you check most. Gmail, Outlook, or text messages. You can always add the others later.

headline: Not
sure?
*Look
after
the
scenes.line: Not sure which one you use? Look at the email address you give your clients. The part after the at sign usually tells you.

headline: Sign
in.
Approve.
*Done.*
scenes.line: Then just sign in, choose your account, and approve access. You'll come straight back to AgentStack.

headline: It
checks
*itself
off.*
scenes.line: Once your account is truly connected, the step checks itself off. No guessing, and nothing marked done until it really is.

headline: Next
up:
*listings.*
scenes.line: Nice work. Next up, your listings. I'll be right here when you're ready.
